$Comment: A spot a bar panel can sit at: the bottom-left, above the hotbar, where your own health and
mana bars are. Measured for the wide World panel: three columns wide, which leaves a skill
name room to be read; pinned to the bottom edge, it grows UPWARD as rows come up and fills each
column from the bottom, so the bar already on screen stays put when the next one opens above
it. Columns 3 with RowsPerColumn 1 spreads the rows sideways before any column goes deep.
Gap leaves a band clear across every column at the same height, so the rows straddle your own
bars rather than climbing into them: AfterRow counts rows from the bottom edge (row 1 is the
row nearest it), the rows up to it sit below the band, and the rest carry on above it. Pixels
is the band's height; the mana bar sits in the band and rides its top edge, so a taller band
lifts the rows above it clear of the bar and puts the bar nearer the band's middle. The pair
shipped here is a starting point: which row the band follows and how tall it is depend on a
screen's own scale and on where that server draws its bars, so change both freely until the
band clears them on your own screen. Either number at zero draws no band, and a column with no
row past AfterRow draws none.
Cutout leaves the cells nearest the bottom edge of ONE column empty, so the panel steps around
what a client draws there: under the third column's lowest rows sit the utility slot and the
left end of the hotbar. Column counts from the panel's own first column, the one at this
spot's left edge, so 3 is the far right here; Rows is how many cells up from the bottom stay
clear. That column's rows start above its cut and stop where the other two columns stop, so it
never stands taller than them: the rows it has no room for go into a row of their own above
the whole block, filled from the left column outward, and another above that if one is not
enough; a row past the panel's nine is left undrawn. Either number at zero, or a Column the
rows never open, cuts nothing.
Position is a corner preset plus pixel offsets from the edges that preset pins (OffsetY here
is measured UP from the bottom). Columns and RowsPerColumn say how the rows spread out here.
Panels lists which panels offer this spot. LabelKey names it in the HUD settings.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'BottomLeft' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-bar-placements.json with only the leaves you want different; a Gap or
Cutout block there restates only the leaf it carries, so {"Gap": {"Pixels": 0}} is enough to
switch the band off and {"Cutout": {"Rows": 0}} to use every cell.
